about.bubbles: Finds the balloons and caption boxes. They are never coloured.
about.flats: Proposes one colour for every zone. Nothing is snapped to your palette yet.
about.panels: Finds the panel borders on the page.
about.zones: Cuts every panel into zones, one flat colour each.
account.sent: A code is on its way to {email}. Type it here.
account.stays: This computer stays signed in until you sign out.
account.why: Sign in to generate flats on the GPU. You type a code once on this computer, and it stays signed in.
account.code_hint: Have a code? Type it on the payment page.
account.plan_none: No colours on this account. Step 5 can still use distinct colours, for free.
account.plan_tester: Tester account: flats on the GPU are on us.
closed.bubbles: Closed: the zones are cut around these balloons. Detect bubbles again to change them — this deletes the zones and everything after them.
closed.panels: Closed: the zones are cut from these panels. Detect panels again to change them — this deletes the zones and everything after them.
closed.zones: Closed: the flats are built on these zones. Segment zones again to change them — this deletes the flats and your snaps.

confirm.bubbles.counted.one: Detect bubbles again? This replaces {count} correction to the balloons.
confirm.bubbles.counted.other: Detect bubbles again? This replaces {count} corrections to the balloons.

confirm.bubbles.unknown: Detect bubbles again? Every balloon you traced or corrected is replaced.
confirm.delete_page: Delete this page? It and every correction on it are deleted. The palette, the references and the other pages stay.

confirm.flats.counted.one: Generate flats again? The zone you snapped goes back to a proposed colour.
confirm.flats.counted.other: Generate flats again? The {count} zones you snapped go back to proposed colours.

confirm.later.all: It also deletes the zones with their merges and cuts, the flats, and your snaps.
confirm.later.flats: It also deletes the flats and your snaps.
confirm.later.zones: It also deletes the zones with their merges and cuts.

confirm.panels.counted.one: Detect panels again? This replaces {count} correction to the panels.
confirm.panels.counted.other: Detect panels again? This replaces {count} corrections to the panels.

confirm.panels.unknown: Detect panels again? Every corner you moved and every panel you drew is replaced.
confirm.zones.counted: Segment zones again? This deletes {merges} and {cuts}.
confirm.zones.unknown: Segment zones again? This deletes every merge and every cut.

done.bubbles.one: {count} balloon found. It is never coloured.
done.bubbles.other: {count} balloons found. They are never coloured.

done.flats.one: {count} segment has a proposed colour. Snap it to your palette next.
done.flats.other: {count} segments have a proposed colour. Snap them to your palette next.

done.page_deleted: Page deleted. The palette, the references and the other pages are still here.
done.page_opened: {name} is open, as you left it.
done.palette: Palette image added. Every colour in it is now in the palette.
done.palette_removed: Palette image removed, with its colours.

done.panels.one: {count} panel found. Correct it here, then detect the bubbles.
done.panels.other: {count} panels found. Correct them here, then detect the bubbles.

done.reference.page.one: Page added whole, plus {count} panel cut from it.
done.reference.page.other: Page added whole, plus {count} panels cut from it.

done.reference_removed: Reference removed. The colours you took from it stay in the palette.

done.zones.one: {count} zone. Merge and cut it before you generate flats.
done.zones.other: {count} zones. Merge and cut them before you generate flats.

error.accounts_unreachable: The account server does not answer. Check the connection and try again.
error.bubbles_closed: The zones are already cut around these balloons. Detect bubbles again to change them.
error.bubbles_first: Detect bubbles first. There is nothing to correct yet.
error.code_too_soon: A code was sent less than a minute ago. Wait a moment, then ask again.
error.code_wrong: That code is wrong or has expired. Ask for another one.
error.colour_invalid: A colour is three numbers from 0 to 255.
error.colour_not_offered: That colour is not one of this reference's.
error.corners_too_few: A shape needs at least three corners.
error.cut_no_split: That stroke does not separate the zone. Draw it right across, from one edge of the zone to the other.
error.cut_too_short: Draw the cut across the zone, from one side to the other.
error.email_invalid: That is not an email address.
error.flats_first: Generate flats first. The steps run in order.
error.gap_share: The largest gap must be between 0 and 100 % of a border.
error.gpu_job_elsewhere: This account is generating flats on another computer right now.
error.gpu_job_running: Flats are already being generated for this account. Wait for them to finish.
error.gpu_no_subscription: This account has no colours for Cobra. Buy some from Account, or choose distinct colours.
error.gpu_proposer_refused: The model could not colour this panel: {detail}
error.gpu_quota_cases: This account has no panels left this month, and no bought panels.
error.gpu_refused: The GPU server refused this panel ({reason}). The fault is in the app, not in your page.
error.gpu_sign_in: Sign in from Account to generate flats on the GPU.
error.gpu_too_many_devices: This account is already used on as many computers as it allows. A computer unused for a month frees its place.
error.gpu_unauthorized: The GPU server did not accept this computer's session. Sign out, then sign in again.
error.gpu_unreachable: The GPU server does not answer. Check the connection and try again.
error.gpu_update: This version of Luikki is too old for the GPU server. Update the app.
error.update_corrupt: The file downloaded is not the published update, so it was not installed. Try again.
error.update_download: The update could not be downloaded. Check the connection and try again.
error.update_none: There is no newer version to install.
error.already_bought: This account already has it. The colour pass adds a year.
error.already_subscribed: This account already has Studio. Manage it from Account.
error.billing_refused: The payment page could not be opened. Try again in a moment.
error.billing_unreachable: The payment server does not answer. Check the connection and try again.
error.needs_luikki: The colour pass extends Luikki. Buy Luikki first.
error.no_customer: This account has nothing to manage on Stripe yet.
error.proposer_unknown: {name} is not a colour mode of this app.
error.granularity_unknown: {value} is not a way to stack the PSD layers.
error.image_empty: That image has no colours to take.
error.image_unreadable: That image could not be read: {detail}
error.last_panel: That is the last panel. A page with no panels has nothing to segment — draw its replacement first.
error.merge_panels: Zones merge inside one panel. For the same thing in another panel, use one palette colour.
error.merge_too_few: Select at least two zones of one panel to merge.
error.network: The app does not answer. Check that luikki serve is still running.
error.palette_kind: A palette image goes in through Add palette image.
error.panels_closed: The zones are already cut from these panels. Detect panels again to change them.
error.panels_first: Detect panels first. The steps run in order.
error.refused: The server refused that. Check the values and try again.
error.segment_no_original: Segment {segment} has no proposed colour to go back to.
error.signed_out: Your session has ended. Sign in again from Account.
error.snap_no_palette: Add a palette colour first. There is nothing to snap to.
error.vault_unavailable: This computer has no password store to keep the session in.
error.zones_closed: The flats are coloured from these zones. Segment zones again to change them — every merge and cut goes with it.
error.zones_first: Segment zones first. The steps run in order.
export.note: Flats only. Put your own line layer on top.

export.warning.other: The PSD will have {count} layers. Most are colours the model proposed, one per segment. Snap them to your palette first.

flats.done.other: {count} segments, each with a proposed colour.

flats.no_colours: This account has no colours or panels for Cobra.
flats.quota_unknown: The account server does not answer, so what is left this month is unknown.
flats.sign_in: Flats are generated on the GPU with your account. Sign in first.
flats.stale: A reference these flats were proposed from has been removed since. They still work: generate them again to use the references you have now.
header.title: {page} · Luikki
hint.bubbles: Click inside a balloon to select it. Drag a corner to move it, click an edge to add one. Click empty page to trace a new balloon — Shift-click traces inside one — and click its first corner to close it. Right-click to delete.
hint.panels: Click inside a panel to select it. Drag a corner to move it, click an edge to add one. Click outside the panels to draw a new one — Shift-click draws inside one — and click its first corner to close it. Right-click to delete.
hint.zones: Press a zone to select it. Hold and sweep to add more, press again to drop one. Right-click to merge, cut or clear.
inspect.bubbles.empty: Click inside a balloon on the page to select it.
inspect.bubbles.not_run: Detect bubbles, then click a balloon to see it here.
inspect.export.title: Export
inspect.flats.not_run: Generate flats to see the segments here.
inspect.flats.title: Flats
inspect.panels.empty: Click inside a panel on the page to select it.
inspect.panels.not_run: Detect panels, then click a panel to see it here.
inspect.snap.delta_close: ΔE {delta}: close to the zone's colour
inspect.snap.delta_far: ΔE {delta}: far from the zone's colour. Look before you snap.
inspect.snap.empty: Click a zone on the page to see its colour and the nearest palette colour.
inspect.snap.no_suggestion: No palette colour to suggest. Add colours to the palette first.
inspect.snap.not_snapped: It already shows what the model proposed.
inspect.snap.taken: It already holds the nearest palette colour.
inspect.snap.title: Panel {panel} · zone {zone}
inspect.upload.empty: Upload a page to begin. The steps then open one by one on the left.
inspect.zones.cut_why: Select exactly one zone to cut it.
inspect.zones.cutting: Draw the cut on the page: press, drag right across the zone, release.
inspect.zones.empty: Press a zone on the page to select it. Hold and sweep to take several.
inspect.zones.merge_why: Select two or more zones of one panel to merge them.
inspect.zones.not_run: Segment zones, then press a zone to select it.
inspector.label: Inspector
pages.about: Every page of this project, saved as you work. Click one to open it.
pages.empty: No pages yet. Upload one to begin.
palette.about: Click a colour to change it on every zone that holds it. Its number never changes.
palette.empty: No colours yet. Take them from a reference, or add a palette image.
rail.label: Steps
refs.about: The model sees these. Their colours are offered: click the ones this book uses.
refs.empty: No references yet. Add a character sheet or a finished page.
snap.hint: Click a zone on the page to decide its colour, or snap every zone at once.
snap.no_palette: Add a palette colour first. There is nothing to snap to.
stage.label: The page
step.bubbles.name: Detect bubbles
step.export.name: Export PSD
step.flats.name: Generate flats
step.panels.name: Detect panels
step.snap.name: Snap colours
step.upload.name: Upload page
step.zones.name: Segment zones
status.colour_changed: Colour changed on every zone that holds it.
status.colour_removed: Colour removed. The zones snapped to it are back to their proposed colours.

status.cut.one: The zone is still in {count} piece.

status.cut_draw: Draw the line the ink was missing: press, drag right across the zone, release.
status.drawing_bubble: Tracing a balloon. Click its first corner to close it, or right-click to stop.
status.drawing_panel: Drawing a panel. Click its first corner to close it, or right-click to stop.
status.no_zone: No zone there. That pixel is line, gutter or a balloon.
status.ready: The page is where you left it.
status.signed_out: Signed out. This computer no longer uses your account.
status.unsnapped: Zone {zone} is back to its proposed colour.
status.update_opened: Luikki {version} is downloading in your browser. Open the file to install it.
status.updating: Luikki {version} is installing. The app closes, then opens again by itself.
status.billing_opened: The page opened in your browser. Come back here once you are done.
toggle.lines_why: Segment zones first. The lines are extracted then.
upload.hint: One page of line art, as an image file.
zones.gap: Largest gap to cut across, in % of a border
zones.gap_tip: Where a hole in a line stops looking like a hole and starts looking like a passage. Raise it to cut more, lower it to cut less. It changes nothing until you segment again.
zoom.fit: Scroll to zoom · Space + drag to move
